title: basic-auth route matching: never add a bare '/' to _PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES or _KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS; key bare paths with the static prefix
answers: Why would adding '/' to the public route suffixes let /api/2.0/ requests skip authorization?
Under --static-prefix, why does my new bare-path basic-auth route not match its validator?
Where does basic-auth decide which paths are public or ungated for the fail-closed net?
body:
Path: The path matching the basic-auth fail-closed net uses to recognise public and ungated routes: `mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_matches_route_suffix` with the `_PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES` list, the `marker in path` branch over `_KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS`, and the import-time route keys built with `mlflow/server/handlers.py:_add_static_prefix`.
Rule: Do not add `/` to `_PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES`: after stripping the suffix, the remainder for `/api/2.0/` is exactly an API-version prefix and would match. Do not add `/` to `_KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS`: the `marker in path` branch matches every path. For a bare (non-ajax) path, key the validator map as `(_add_static_prefix(path), method)`; `_get_ajax_path` constants already carry the static prefix, so applying it again would double it.
Constraints: Basic-auth app only. Route keys are built at import time from the static prefix, so a test that changes STATIC_PREFIX_ENV_VAR must reload `mlflow.server.auth.routes` and restore it afterwards, as `tests/server/auth/test_fail_closed_flag.py` does.
Applies: Any change to public or ungated route matching, or to static-prefix route keys in the basic-auth app.
applies: Basic-auth public/ungated route matching and static-prefix route keys in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py.
says: The tracking server allows anonymous access to all API endpoints without requiring login.
Deploying the server under a custom base URL path breaks endpoint access control rules.
Non-ajax routes configured under a static prefix fail to enforce their security validators.
Ensure public route exemptions do not accidentally make every protected API path accessible.
search: In basic-auth fail-closed route matching, never add a bare '/' to _PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES or _KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, as doing so inadvertently matches all API routes or every path. When registering bare non-ajax routes in the validator map under --static-prefix, key them using (_add_static_prefix(path), method) while avoiding duplicating prefixes already embedded in _get_ajax_path constants. Because route keys are computed at import time, tests modifying STATIC_PREFIX_ENV_VAR must reload mlflow.server.auth.routes and restore the environment afterward. Applies strictly to public and ungated route matching and static-prefix route key registration within the basic-auth application.
